title: Ship-By Dates and Delay Limits by Reservation Type — Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Schedule
content:
Every Pre-Orders & Back-Orders reservation carries a promised ship-by date, and every delay to that date is measured against limits fixed per reservation type. All periods below are calendar days.

| | Standard Back-Order | Supplier Direct Back-Order | Seasonal Pre-Order | Launch Pre-Order | Deposit Pre-Order | Made-to-Order Reservation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Furthest initial ship-by date, days after the reservation date | 21 | 30 | 120 | 60 | 90 | 56 |
| Ship-by date when no date can be stated, days after the reservation date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Largest delay a first notice may announce while silence counts as consent, days beyond the original ship-by date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Notice number from which express consent is always required | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Latest moment a delay notice may be sent | On or before the current ship-by date | On or before the current ship-by date | On or before the current ship-by date | On or before the current ship-by date | On or before the current ship-by date | On or before the current ship-by date |
| Deadline for express consent | The current ship-by date before revision | The current ship-by date before revision | The current ship-by date before revision | The current ship-by date before revision | The current ship-by date before revision | The current ship-by date before revision |
| Largest cumulative delay, days beyond the original ship-by date, after which the reservation is cancelled instead of delayed again | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 120 | 60 |

**Notes on the columns**

- The original ship-by date is the date promised when the reservation was made. Both the deemed-consent limit and the cumulative-delay limit are counted from that original date, never from a later revised date.
- The 30-day unstated period is the same for every type. The furthest initial ship-by date is what differs: it runs from 21 days (Standard Back-Order) to 120 days (Seasonal Pre-Order).
- The cumulative limit is 90 days for four types, 120 days for the Deposit Pre-Order and 60 days for the Made-to-Order Reservation.

**Illustration (hypothetical dates)**

A Deposit Pre-Order whose original ship-by date is 1 March sits within its cumulative limit for any revised date up to 120 days after 1 March. A Made-to-Order Reservation with the same original date reaches its limit at 60 days. A first notice moving either one by no more than 30 days beyond 1 March is within the deemed-consent size. A first notice moving it by 31 days or more is not.
